digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store bootstrap
propositions: rebar init must not create an orphan branch when a configured remote-tracking ref exists but cannot be fetched due to network failure or timeout
git ls-remote probe must distinguish three states: remote advertises branch (code 0), remote reachable but branch absent (code 2), remote unreachable or probe timeout (code 124)
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remote as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, never supplying force_new_store=True
explicit init and strict auto-init must fail closed with actionable error when remote is unreachable, never creating an orphan unless --force-new-store flag is supplied

all four consumers (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share one cached tri-state remote-branch probe result per invocation to bound probe timeout cost to one per CLI call

--force-new-store flag and force_new_store=True keyword must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; when remote is reachable, flag has no effect and normal fetch/mount logic applies
